articles.title: South Korean President Lee to visit Beijing for pivotal 2nd summit with Xi
articles.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping has extended an invitation to South Korean President Lee Jae Myung for a state visit to Beijing. This diplomatic initiative signals China's clear intent to strengthen bilateral relations with South Korea. The invitation comes at a time of significant regional turbulence, suggesting a strategic move by China to reinforce crucial partnerships amidst a complex geopolitical environment and foster greater stability.
